motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Ruzzin to approve consent items 3A through 3L with items 3-C, 3-H and 3-L removed.

Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Havlick to direct the City Manager to identify a public process and implement a public forum where the public can express its best ideas for where and how much C.U. should expand and then following the pubic forum reconvene negotiations between the City and C.U.
Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to approve the recommendations from the Integrated Pest Management Task Force.

A motion to direct the City Manager to conduct a public forum to solicit public input as to possible alternate development sites for C.U., to happen concurrently with discussions between the City and C.U.
Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Ruzzin to suspend the rules and continue the meeting.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6:4; Corson, Eldridge, Havlick and Riggle opposed.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Riggle to approve, as City Council, items related to 9 th and Canyon.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:1; Havlick opposed; Eldridge recused.

motions.motion_text: Board Member Mock moved, seconded by Riggle to approve, as the Central Area General Improvement District Board of Directors, items related to 9 th and Canyon.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:1; Havlick opposed; Eldridge recused.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Morzel to suspend the rules and continue the meeting.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:1; Havlick opposed; Eldridge recused.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Eldridge moved, seconded by Riggle to postpone the the findings of fact in order to commission an independent expert(s) to examine the property and to return to Council to provide testimony regarding the reports(s) with the opportunity for cross examination by the applicant.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 6:3, Corson, Havlick and Ruzzin opposed.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7279 amending Title 9, “Land Use Regulation,” B.R.C. 1981, by amending standards related to the landscaping.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7280 designating the structure and its site located at 1625 Pine, also known as the Chauncey Stokes House, as an individual landmark under the city of Boulder Historic Preservation Code.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7281 amending Ordinance No. 7203 (2002) designating the structure and a portion of its site located at 4789 28 th Street, also known as the Holiday Drive-In Marquee, as an individual landmark under the city of Boulder Historic Preservation Code.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7282 amending Title 4, B.R.C., 1981 creating a system of publicly installed news boxes on three corners within the Downtown Boulder Business Improvement District.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7283 amending Chapter 4-11, B.R.C., 1981 making changes to the Pearl Street Mall permitting system and amending the Mall zone maps.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7284 amending section 9-6-2 Growth Management, definition of “Mixed Use Development,” adding Residential Main Street (RMS-X) zones to the list of exempt mixed use zones.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7285 approving and authorizing the issuance of Boulder Municipal Property Authority Lease Purchase Revenue Note, Series 2003A, in the aggregate principal amount of $715,000, and approving and authorizing a Lease Purchase Agreement for the purchase of 57.4 acres of land together with 1 - 1/8 shares of the Original Cottonwood Ditch and 1/4 mineral rights located at 2500 75 th Street from Helayne B. Jones for Open Space and Mountain Parks purposes.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7286 amending Chapter 2-7, B.R.C. 1981, expanding the scope of regulations regarding standards of conduct and ethics for City Councilmembers, members of City boards, commissions, or task forces and City employees.
There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 11:25 P.M..
